test_item:
The Cert Provider feature shall verify the integrity and authenticity of an X.509 leaf certificate provided by an external application.
(valid leaf certificate; chain verification passes)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Test runner CertProviderServiceManagerTest.apk is installed
3. A valid leaf certificate and its chain are available under SecurityAssets/oem-certs/cert-provider/
proc:
1. Run the OpenSSL chain verification of the leaf certificate on the host
$ openssl verify -verbose -CAfile RootCert.pem -untrusted L1.pem -untrusted L2.pem -untrusted L3.pem SAMcert.pem
2. Run the Cert Provider instrumentation test for the FOTA MCPU certificate normal flow
$ adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.melcocertprovider.libcertproviderservice.test.CertProviderServiceManagerTest#fotaMcpuCertTestNormalFlow com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.melcocertprovider.libcertproviderservice.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner
3. Confirm the Cert Provider log after the instrumentation run
$ adb logcat -s MelcoCertProviderTest
er:
1. The openssl command prints "SAMcert.pem: OK" on stdout
2. The instrumentation runner reports "OK (1 test)" for fotaMcpuCertTestNormalFlow
3. The adb logcat -s MelcoCertProviderTest output contains no error entry for the leaf certificate
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
author: PeiPYHsu
